items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: A counter or dot on an icon or avatar, cut out with CSS shape() so it reads on any background

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A step-by-step flow with a segmented progress bar and CSS-only step transitions

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint
items.description: A labeled trigger that opens a help bubble, its hit area stretched by a pseudo-element

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: A list that loads more as you scroll, down or up, with a reverse mode held in place by CSS alone

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A strip that loops its items only once CSS scroll-driven animations detect they overflow

items.name: item-inset-separator
items.title: Item Inset Separator
items.description: A divider under an Item that starts at its content, past the media, placed with CSS anchor positioning

items.name: dialog-drawer
items.title: Dialog Drawer
items.description: A responsive Dialog: a centered Dialog at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Dialog on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, open state kept across the breakpoint, footer close button on both sides, plus a drawer={{...}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: sheet-drawer
items.title: Sheet Drawer
items.description: A responsive Sheet: a side Sheet at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px, opening from the edge set with side. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Sheet on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, open state kept across the breakpoint, plus a drawer={{...}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: popover-drawer
items.title: Popover Drawer
items.description: A responsive Popover: an anchored Popover at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Popover on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, Anchor included on Radix, open state kept across the breakpoint, plus a drawer={{...}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: tooltip-popover
items.title: Tooltip Popover
items.description: A responsive Tooltip for infotips: a hover Tooltip at desktop that becomes a tap-to-open Popover below 768px, because hover does not exist on touch. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Tooltip on Base UI or Radix (Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent): desktop props 1:1, open state kept across the breakpoint, plus a popover={{...}} override typed on your Popover.

items.name: easy-modal
items.title: Easy Modal
items.description: Modal component for react-easy-modals with Base UI Dialog. Supports nested modals.
